title: Graphs of high chromatic number and large girth
statement: For every integer $k \ge 2$, there exists a finite simple graph $H$ whose chromatic number is at least $k$ and whose girth is at least $6$; that is, $H$ cannot be properly colored with fewer than $k$ colors, yet every cycle in $H$ has length at least $6$.
hypotheses_covered: conclusion: exists finite simple graph H
replaced:
\emph{Deduce that, for any
\texttt{k $\ge$ 2}, there exists a \texttt{k}-chromatic graph of girth six.}
